slides.text: Call the server like a function 📞
slides.say: Server Functions let Client Components call async functions that run on the server.
Mark an async function with use server. Here a Server Component defines it and passes it to a Client Component button.

slides.text: The client gets a reference. Calling it sends a request; the server runs it and returns the result.
slides.say: The framework passes a reference, not the code. When the button calls it, React sends a request to the server, runs the function, and returns the result.

slides.text: Can also live in a "use server" file and be imported by Client Components.
slides.say: You can also put Server Functions in a file marked use server, and import them into Client Components. Passed to a form action, they are called Server Actions.
